confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Paphos resort pricing for July, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is the least certain, since July rates vary widely by season, booking lead time and property quality. Hostel anchors are the most uncertain because the local hostel supply is thin. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price relationship.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on eurozone Mediterranean seaside resort towns with similar July tourist demand and price levels, adjusted for Cyprus's cost base. No specific comparable city was used as a direct price source.
